# Single-cell analysis - Pipeline 2 - Immune cell phenotypes ccRCC

Here, we will perform the second single cell analysis steps, including phenotyping immune cells.

## Read in data
First, we will read in the `SingleCellExperiment` object containing the cleaned single-cell data of ccRCC origin. 

```{r read-data-batch-correction, message=FALSE}
sce <- readRDS("/mnt/rcc_volume/RCC/IMC/pan_immune/data_analysis/sce_panimmune_RCC_03.rds")
```

## Filter sce for immune cells
Here, we will filter for immune cells based on the cluster category and GMM approach.

```{r filter sce, message=FALSE}
#based on cluster categories (n=175493)
sce <- sce[,colData(sce)$cluster_category == "immune"]
sce
```

## Define markers for clustering

```{r immune_markers, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE}
cluster_channel = c("MPO","CD7","CD38","HLA_DR","CD68","LAG3","CD20","CD163","IDO","CD3","DC_LAMP","CD11c","PD1","CD16","GranB","TCF1_7","FOXP3","CD278","CD8a","TMEM173","CD33","Arginase", "VISTA", "CD40", "CD4","CD206","Ki67")

cellstate_other_channel = c("CD45RA","SMA","CD34","PDGFRB","PDL1","CD31","CXCL12", "HLA_ABC","cCASPARP", "Vimentin","CD14","CD99","CD15")

#Add to sce
rowData(sce)$cluster_channel <- (rowData(sce)$clean_target %in% cluster_channel)
rowData(sce)$cellstate_other_channel <- (rowData(sce)$clean_target %in% cellstate_other_channel)
```

## Perform overclustering and hierarchical clustering
Next, we will run Rphenograph (Jaccard-based weights, Louvain clustering as community detection algorithm) clustering with different resolution parameters (k=30,50,75,100). 

```{r overcluster, message=FALSE}
#k=30
set.seed(22)
snn.sce <- buildSNNGraph(sce[rowData(sce)$cluster_channel==TRUE,], k=30, 
                         d = NA, 
                         type = "jaccard",
                         assay.type = "exprs",
                         BNPARAM=AnnoyParam(),
                         BPPARAM = MulticoreParam(workers = (detectCores()-2), progressbar = TRUE)
                         )

clusters_3 <- igraph::cluster_louvain(snn.sce)
sce$cluster_30 <- as.factor(clusters_3$membership)
unique(sce$cluster_30)

#Save SCEs after clustering
saveRDS(sce, "/mnt/rcc_volume/RCC/IMC/pan_immune/data_analysis/sce_panimmune_RCC_04.rds")


#k=50
set.seed(22)
snn.sce <- buildSNNGraph(sce[rowData(sce)$cluster_channel==TRUE,], k=50, 
                         d = NA, 
                         type = "jaccard",
                         assay.type = "exprs",
                         BNPARAM=AnnoyParam(),
                         BPPARAM = MulticoreParam(workers = (detectCores()-2), progressbar = TRUE)
                         )

clusters <- igraph::cluster_louvain(snn.sce)
sce$cluster_50 <- as.factor(clusters$membership)
unique(sce$cluster_50)

#Save SCEs after clustering
saveRDS(sce, "/mnt/rcc_volume/RCC/IMC/pan_immune/data_analysis/sce_panimmune_RCC_04.rds")

#k=75
set.seed(22)
snn.sce <- buildSNNGraph(sce[rowData(sce)$cluster_channel==TRUE,], k=75, 
                         d = NA, 
                         type = "jaccard",
                         assay.type = "exprs",
                         BNPARAM=AnnoyParam(),
                         BPPARAM = MulticoreParam(workers = (detectCores()-2), progressbar = TRUE)
                         )

clusters_1 <- igraph::cluster_louvain(snn.sce)
sce$cluster_75 <- as.factor(clusters_1$membership)
unique(sce$cluster_75)

#Save SCEs after clustering
saveRDS(sce, "/mnt/rcc_volume/RCC/IMC/pan_immune/data_analysis/sce_panimmune_RCC_04.rds")

#k=100
set.seed(22)
snn.sce <- buildSNNGraph(sce[rowData(sce)$cluster_channel==TRUE,], k=100, 
                         d = NA, 
                         type = "jaccard",
                         assay.type = "exprs",
                         BNPARAM=AnnoyParam(),
                         BPPARAM = MulticoreParam(workers = (detectCores()-2), progressbar = TRUE)
                         )

clusters_2 <- igraph::cluster_louvain(snn.sce)
sce$cluster_100 <- as.factor(clusters_2$membership)
unique(sce$cluster_100)

#Save SCEs after clustering
saveRDS(sce, "/mnt/rcc_volume/RCC/IMC/pan_immune/data_analysis/sce_panimmune_RCC_04.rds")
```

### Cluster stability testing and comparison

```{r clustree, message = FALSE, warning=FALSE}
#Read sce after clustering
sce <- readRDS("/mnt/rcc_volume/RCC/IMC/pan_immune/data_analysis/sce_panimmune_RCC_04.rds")

#Pairwise rand index 
#Agreement between two clustering approaches - ARI > 0.5 = "good" similarity
pairwiseRand(sce$cluster_30,sce$cluster_50, mode = "index")
pairwiseRand(sce$cluster_50,sce$cluster_75, mode = "index")
pairwiseRand(sce$cluster_75,sce$cluster_100, mode = "index")

#Over different resolution parameters - Silhouette width [-1,1,max], Purity[0,1,max], Root-mean-squared difference [min]
clusters <- colnames(colData(sce))[str_detect(colnames(colData(sce)),"cluster_[:digit:]")]
df <- foreach(i = seq_along(clusters),.combine = rbind) %do% {
num_clus <- length(unique(colData(sce)[,clusters[i]]))
sil <- approxSilhouette(t(assay(sce, "exprs")), clusters=colData(sce)[,clusters[i]])
#purity <- neighborPurity(t(assay(sce, "exprs")), clusters=colData(sce)[,clusters[i]]) #takes very long to compute - do once and then save figure
rmsd <- clusterRMSD(t(assay(sce, "exprs")), clusters=colData(sce)[,clusters[i]])
data.frame(num_clus = num_clus,
           k = as.numeric(str_split(clusters[i],"_",simplify = TRUE)[,2]), 
           sil = mean(sil$width), 
#           purity = mean(purity$purity),
           rmsd = sum(rmsd))
}


p1 <- ggplot(df, aes(x=k, y=num_clus))+ 
  geom_line(lwd = 2,color = "#377EB8")+
  theme_classic()
p2 <- ggplot(df, aes(x=k, y=sil))+ 
  geom_line(lwd = 2,color = "#377EB8")+
  theme_classic()
p3 <- ggplot(df, aes(x=k, y=rmsd))+ 
  geom_line(lwd = 2,color = "#377EB8")+
  theme_classic()

p1+p3+p2 

#Chosen method => k=100

#Cluster colors 
col_clus <- colorRampPalette(brewer.pal(9,"Paired"))(length(unique(sce$cluster_100)))

#By clusters for one method (here k=100)
#1. Silhouette width [-1,1]
#Clusters with large positive silhouette widths are well-separated from other clusters
sil.approx <- approxSilhouette(t(assay(sce, "exprs")), clusters=sce$cluster_100)
sil.data <- as.data.frame(sil.approx)
sil.data$closest <- factor(ifelse(sil.data$width > 0, sce$cluster_100, sil.data$other))
sil.data$cluster <- sce$cluster_100

p4 <- ggplot(sil.data, aes(x=cluster, y=width, colour=closest)) +
    ggbeeswarm::geom_quasirandom(method="smiley")+
  theme_classic()+
  scale_color_manual(values = col_clus)
p4

# #By neighborpurity (takes very long to be computed - optional)
# pure.approx <- neighborPurity(t(assay(sce, "exprs")), clusters=sce$cluster_100)
# pure.data <- as.data.frame(pure.approx)
# pure.data$maximum <- factor(pure.data$maximum)
# pure.data$cluster <- sce$cluster_100
# 
# p5 <- ggplot(pure.data, aes(x=cluster, y=purity, colour=maximum)) +
#     ggbeeswarm::geom_quasirandom(method="smiley")+
#   theme_classic()+
#   scale_color_manual(values = col_clus)
# p5 
```

Observation:  
- Highest Silhouette width and WCSS for k=50 => selected

## Heatmap 

Heatmaps with different scales

```{r heatmap scales, message=FALSE,warning=FALSE}
#Read sce after clustering and GMM
#sce <- readRDS("/mnt/rcc_volume/RCC/IMC/pan_immune/data_analysis/sce_panimmune_RCC_04.rds")

#Heatmap body colors
col_exprs <- colorRamp2(c(0,1,2,3,4), c("#440154FF","#3B518BFF","#20938CFF","#6ACD5AFF","#FDE725FF"))
col_min_max <- colorRamp2(c(0,0.2,0.4,0.6,0.8), c("#440154FF", "#33628DFF", "#28AE80FF", "#DBE318FF", "#FDE725FF"))

### 1. Mean exprs counts
#Aggregrate across cells with the mean (median is also possible)
cluster_mean_sce <- aggregateAcrossCells(sce, ids = sce$cluster_100,
                                 statistics = "mean",
                                 use.assay.type = "exprs",
                                 subset.row = rowData(sce)$cluster_channel)

cellstate_mean_sce <- aggregateAcrossCells(sce, ids = sce$cluster_100,
                                 statistics = "mean",
                                 use.assay.type = "exprs",
                                 subset.row = rowData(sce)$cellstate_other_channel)


h_exprs <- Heatmap(t(assay(cluster_mean_sce, "exprs")),
        column_title = "1. mean exprs",
        col = col_exprs,
        name= "mean exprs",
        km = 1,
        show_row_names = T, 
        show_column_names =  T,

Heatmap(t(assay(cellstate_mean_sce, "exprs")),

        km = 1,
        show_row_names = T,
        show_column_names =  T,
        clustering_method_rows = "ward.D2",
        clustering_method_columns = "ward.D2")

h_exprs
```

## Optional: Cluster merging of similar clusters with clear phenotype (e.g. 3 and 13, 2 and 8)

```{r cluster merg}
sce$cluster_100_merg <- sce$cluster_100
sce$cluster_100_merg <- ifelse(sce$cluster_100_merg %in% c("3","13"), "3_13", sce$cluster_100_merg)
sce$cluster_100_merg <- ifelse(sce$cluster_100_merg %in% c("2","8"), "2_8", sce$cluster_100_merg)
sce$cluster_100_merg <- as.factor(sce$cluster_100_merg)

cluster_100_merg_df <- data.frame(cluster_100_merg = unique(sce$cluster_100_merg), cluster_100_merg_names = 1:12) #define new and sorted cluster names
sce$cluster_100_renamed <- cluster_100_merg_df$cluster_100_merg_names[match(sce$cluster_100_merg,cluster_100_merg_df$cluster_100_merg)] 
sce$cluster_100_renamed <- as.factor(sce$cluster_100_renamed)
```

Rich heatmap of clusters with additional information (other channels, spatial, grade, subtype)

```{r heatmap sce_1, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
#Read sce after clustering and GMM
#sce <- readRDS("/mnt/rcc_volume/RCC/IMC/pan_immune/data_analysis/sce_panimmune_RCC_04.rds")

### 1. Marker Heatmaps (Cluster channels, other_immune channels)

#Aggregrate across cells with the mean (median is also possible)
cluster_mean_sce <- aggregateAcrossCells(sce, ids = sce$cluster_100_renamed,
                                 statistics = "mean",
                                 use.assay.type = "min_max",
                                 subset.row = rowData(sce)$cluster_channel)

cellstate_mean_sce <- aggregateAcrossCells(sce, ids = sce$cluster_100_renamed,
                                 statistics = "mean",
                                 use.assay.type = "min_max",
                                 subset.row = rowData(sce)$cellstate_other_channel)


### 2. Spatial Heatmap
#Add number of neighbors to sce object (saved in ColPair)
n_neighbors <- colPair(sce) %>% as.data.frame() %>% group_by(from) %>% count() %>% arrange(desc(n))

sce$n_neighbors <- n_neighbors$n[match(seq_along(colnames(sce)),n_neighbors$from)]
sce$n_neighbors <- sce$n_neighbors %>% replace_na(0)

#Select spatial features and average over clusters 
spatial <- colData(sce) %>% as.data.frame %>% select(area,eccentricity,cluster_100_renamed,n_neighbors)
spatial <- spatial %>% select(-cluster_100_renamed) %>% aggregate(by = list(cluster_100_renamed = spatial$cluster_100_renamed), FUN = mean) %>% column_to_rownames("cluster_100_renamed")

#Create Spatial Heatmap Annotation
ha_spatial = HeatmapAnnotation(
    area = spatial$area,
    eccentricity = spatial$eccentricity,
    n_neighbors = spatial$n_neighbors, 
    col = list(area = colorRamp2(c(min(spatial$area),median(spatial$area),max(spatial$area)), c(brewer.pal(3,"Blues")[1],brewer.pal(3,"Blues")[2],brewer.pal(3,"Blues")[3])),
               eccentricity = colorRamp2(c(min(spatial$eccentricity ),median(spatial$eccentricity ),max(spatial$eccentricity)), c(brewer.pal(3,"Greens")[1],brewer.pal(3,"Greens")[2],brewer.pal(3,"Greens")[3])),
               n_neighbors = colorRamp2(c(min(spatial$n_neighbors ),median(spatial$n_neighbors ),max(spatial$n_neighbors)),c(brewer.pal(3,"Oranges")[1],brewer.pal(3,"Oranges")[2],brewer.pal(3,"Oranges")[3]))
    ),
    border = TRUE,
    which = "row")

###3.  Define annotation dataframe with n cells, clusters and names for clusters
anno <- colData(cluster_mean_sce) %>% as.data.frame %>% select(cluster_100_renamed, ncells)

#Annotate clusters
anno_clus <- as.character(sce$cluster_100_renamed)

anno_clus[anno_clus == "1"] <- "Macro_CD68+"
anno_clus[anno_clus == "2"] <- "CD8_T"
anno_clus[anno_clus == "3"] <- "HLA_DR+"
anno_clus[anno_clus == "4"] <- "Arginase+"
anno_clus[anno_clus == "5"] <- "Marker_low"
anno_clus[anno_clus == "6"] <- "CD4_T"
anno_clus[anno_clus == "7"] <- "TMEM173/VISTA+"
anno_clus[anno_clus == "8"] <- "NK_GranB+"
anno_clus[anno_clus == "9"] <- "Neutro"
anno_clus[anno_clus == "10"] <- "B_cells"
anno_clus[anno_clus == "11"] <- "Macro_CD206+"
anno_clus[anno_clus == "12"] <- "Plasma_CD38+"

anno$names <- unique(anno_clus)
sce$cluster_names <- anno_clus

###4. Patient metadata - grade / lehmann subtype

# Proportion of ISUP grade per cluster
ISUP <- colData(sce) %>% as.data.frame() %>% select(cluster_100_renamed,ISUP) %>% group_by(cluster_100_renamed) %>% table() %>% as.data.frame
ISUP <- ISUP %>% group_by(cluster_100_renamed) %>% mutate(fra = Freq/sum(Freq)) 
ISUP <- ISUP %>% select(-Freq) %>% pivot_wider(id_cols = cluster_100_renamed,names_from = ISUP,values_from = fra) %>% column_to_rownames("cluster_100_renamed")

# Proportion of stage per cluster
pT_simple <- colData(sce) %>% as.data.frame() %>% select(cluster_100_renamed,pT_simple) %>% group_by(cluster_100_renamed) %>% table() %>% as.data.frame
pT_simple <- pT_simple %>% group_by(cluster_100_renamed) %>% mutate(fra = Freq/sum(Freq)) 
pT_simple <- pT_simple %>% select(-Freq) %>% pivot_wider(id_cols = cluster_100_renamed,names_from = pT_simple,values_from = fra) %>% column_to_rownames("cluster_100_renamed")

# Proportion of necrose per cluster
necrose <- colData(sce) %>% as.data.frame() %>% select(cluster_100_renamed,necrose) %>% group_by(cluster_100_renamed) %>% table() %>% as.data.frame
necrose <- necrose %>% group_by(cluster_100_renamed) %>% mutate(fra = Freq/sum(Freq)) 
necrose <- necrose %>% select(-Freq) %>% pivot_wider(id_cols = cluster_100_renamed,names_from = necrose,values_from = fra) %>% column_to_rownames("cluster_100_renamed")

# Proportion of lymphocytes per cluster 
lymphocytes <- colData(sce) %>% as.data.frame() %>% select(cluster_100_renamed,lymphocytes) %>% group_by(cluster_100_renamed) %>% table() %>% as.data.frame
lymphocytes <- lymphocytes %>% group_by(cluster_100_renamed) %>% mutate(fra = Freq/sum(Freq)) 
lymphocytes <- lymphocytes %>% select(-Freq) %>% pivot_wider(id_cols = cluster_100_renamed,names_from = lymphocytes,values_from = fra) %>% column_to_rownames("cluster_100_renamed")


# Number of contributing patients/samples per cluster
cluster_SID <- colData(sce) %>% as.data.frame() %>% select(cluster_100_renamed,sample_id) %>% group_by(cluster_100_renamed) %>% table() %>% as.data.frame
n_SID <- cluster_SID %>% filter(Freq>0) %>% group_by(cluster_100_renamed) %>% count(name = "n_SID") %>% column_to_rownames("cluster_100_renamed")

###6. General heatmap color schemes 
#Heatmap body color 
col_min_max <- colorRamp2(c(0,0.2,0.4,0.6,0.8), c("#440154FF", "#33628DFF", "#28AE80FF", "#DBE318FF", "#FDE725FF"))

#retrieve row_order for sequential color scheme

        column_title = "cluster_channels",

        name= "mean min_max exprs",
        km = 1,
        show_row_names = T, 
        show_column_names =  T, 
        clustering_method_rows = "ward.D2",
        clustering_method_columns = "ward.D2"))


#Color scheme for clusters
col <- list(cluster_100_renamed = colorRampPalette(brewer.pal(9, "Paired"))(length(unique(anno$cluster_100_renamed))))
col_clusters <- col[[1]]
names(col_clusters) = row_order_clusters
col_clusters <- list(col_clusters)
names(col_clusters) <- "cluster_100_renamed"

#Add color schemes 
col_clusters$metaclusters <- col_clusters$cluster_100_renamed[order(as.numeric(names(col_clusters$cluster_100_renamed)))][1:12]

col <- list(pT_simple = c(colorRampPalette(brewer.pal(9, "Blues"))(length(unique(sce$pT_simple))-1),"black"),
           ISUP = c(colorRampPalette(brewer.pal(9, "Reds"))(length(unique(sce$ISUP))-1),"black"),
           necrose = c(colorRampPalette(brewer.pal(9, "Purples"))(length(unique(sce$necrose))-1),"black"),
           lymphocytes = c(colorRampPalette(brewer.pal(9, "Greens"))(length(unique(sce$lymphocytes))-1),"black")
)

col_list_1 <- foreach(i=1:4, .packages="foreach") %do% {
  color= col[[i]]
  names(color)= sort(unique(colData(sce)[,names(col)[i]]))
  color
}
names(col_list_1) <- c(names(col))

###7. Plot combined Heatmap
h <- Heatmap(t(assay(cluster_mean_sce, "min_max")),
        column_title = "cluster_channels",
```

## Visualization images of clusters

## Load masks and images 

```{r masks images}
#Load images and masks
masks <- readRDS("/mnt/rcc_volume/RCC/IMC/pan_immune/data_analysis/masks_nucexp_panimmune_RCC.rds")
images <- readRDS("/mnt/rcc_volume/RCC/IMC/pan_immune/data_analysis/images_panimmune_RCC.rds")


## Plot cell features onto image using cytomapper
img_ids <- colData(sce) %>% as.data.frame() %>% select(sample_id,cluster_75) %>% filter(cluster_75 == "5") %>% count(sample_id,sort = TRUE) %>% slice(1:10) %>% pull(sample_id)

# Normalize and clip image
cur_images <- images[img_ids]
cur_images <- cytomapper::normalize(cur_images, separateImages = TRUE)
cur_images <- cytomapper::normalize(cur_images, inputRange = c(0, 0.2))

mcols(masks)
#Plot pixels 
plotPixels(cur_images,
```

```{r diff abun}
### Differential abundance analysis based on edgeR
library(edgeR)

## 1. For clusters and pT stage
#cluster abundances per PID
sce$sample_stage <- paste0(sce$sample_id, "_", sce$pT_merg)
abundances <- colData(sce) %>% as.data.frame %>%
  group_by(sample_id, pT_merg, cluster_100_renamed) %>%
  summarize(count = n())  %>%
  filter(!is.na(pT_merg)) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = c(sample_id, pT_merg), 
              values_from = count, values_fill = 0) %>%
  as.data.frame() %>% column_to_rownames("cluster_100_renamed")

#relevant patient metadata (Relevel so that pT 1/2 is baseline)
meta <- colData(sce)[match(colnames(abundances), sce$sample_stage),]
rownames(meta) <- meta$sample_stage
meta$pT_merg <- relevel(x=factor(meta$pT_merg), ref = "1/2") #already correct

#Visualize
# logCPM of abundances per cluster
cur_mat <- cpm(abundances,prior.count = 1,log = TRUE)

Heatmap(cur_mat, 
        col = viridis(100),
        column_split = unfactor(meta$pT_merg))%v%
  columnAnnotation(pT_merg = anno_simple(unfactor(meta$pT_merg)))

#create DGEList - based on edgeR package
y.ab <- DGEList(abundances, samples=meta, group = meta$pT_merg)

#Design matrix
design <- model.matrix(~pT_merg, data = y.ab$samples)

# Estimate NB and QL dispersion 
y.ab <- estimateDisp(y.ab, design, trend="none")
summary(y.ab$common.dispersion)
plotBCV(y.ab, cex=1)

fit.ab <- glmQLFit(y.ab, design, robust=TRUE, abundance.trend=FALSE)
summary(fit.ab$var.prior)
plotQLDisp(fit.ab, cex=1)

# Test for differential abundance of clusters between tumor stages
res <- glmQLFTest(fit.ab, coef=ncol(design))

res$coefficients
summary(decideTests(res))

DA <- res$table
DA <- topTags(res, n = 12, adjust.method = "BH")$table

DA <- DA %>% mutate(cluster = rownames(DA), sign = DA$FDR<0.05, result = ifelse(DA$logFC > 0 & DA$FDR < 0.05, "UP",ifelse(DA$logFC < 0 & DA$FDR < 0.05, "DOWN", "NOTSIG"))) %>% 
  arrange(desc(logFC))

DA$cluster <- factor(DA$cluster, levels = DA$cluster)

sig <- DA %>% filter(FDR<0.05) %>% pull(cluster) %>% unfactor

## Visualize
#Barplot
ggplot(DA, aes(cluster, y = logFC))+
  geom_col(aes(fill=result), col = "black")+
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("#377EB8","lightgrey","#E41A1C"))+
  ylab("logFC")+
  xlab("Cluster")+
  labs(fill = "FDR<0.05")+
  ggtitle("pT_stage (1/2 vs 3/4)")+
  theme_classic()
#Volcano plot  
ggplot(DA, aes(x = logFC, y = -log10(FDR)))+
  geom_point(aes(col=cluster, size = -log10(FDR)))+
  scale_color_manual(values = col_clusters$cluster_100_renamed)+
  xlab("logFC (pT: 1/2 vs 3/4)")+
  ylab("-log10(FDR)")+
  theme_classic()+
  geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(0.05), linetype = "dashed")+
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed")+
  labs(color = "cluster")
#Abundance vs log fold change (best?)
DA_stage_p <- ggplot(DA, aes(x = logFC, y = logCPM))+
  geom_point(aes(col= cluster, 
                 size = -log10(FDR)))+
  geom_label_repel(data = DA %>% filter(FDR<0.05), aes(label = cluster))+
  scale_color_manual(values = ifelse(DA$cluster %in% sig, col_clusters$cluster_100_renamed[match(DA$cluster,names(col_clusters$cluster_100_renamed))], "black"))+
  xlab("logFC (pT: 1/2 vs 3/4)")+
  ylab("Abundance (logCPM)")+
  theme_classic()+
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed")+
  labs(color = "cluster")

DA_stage_p
pT_cluster_p + DA_stage_p
```

## Cox-proportonal hazards model for clusters

### Add survival data to sce

```{r add surv}
#read in patient and image metadata
patient_meta <- read_csv("/mnt/rcc_volume/RCC/IMC/pan_immune/data_analysis/data/Metadata_combined_RCC.csv")
images_meta <- read_csv("/mnt/rcc_volume/RCC/IMC/pan_immune/images.csv",col_names = TRUE)
images_meta$names <- str_split(images_meta$image,".tiff",simplify = TRUE)[,1]
images_meta$TMA_id <- str_split(images_meta$acquisition_description," ",simplify = TRUE)[,1]

patient_meta$sample_id <- images_meta$names[match(patient_meta$TMA_id,images_meta$TMA_id)]

#Add survival data to sce
patient_meta$censor_dead_0_alive_1 #censor needs correction (dead = 1 ("an event"), alive/censored = 0 ("no event"))
patient_meta$censor_corrected <- ifelse(patient_meta$censor_dead_0_alive_1 == 1, 0, ifelse(patient_meta$censor_dead_0_alive_1 == 0, 1, NA))

sce$censor_corrected <- patient_meta$censor_corrected[match(sce$sample_id,patient_meta$sample_id)]
sce$survival_months <- patient_meta$survival_months[match(sce$sample_id,patient_meta$sample_id)]

#save updated metadata
write_csv(patient_meta,"/mnt/rcc_volume/RCC/IMC/pan_immune/data_analysis/data/Metadata_combined_RCC.csv")
```


### For OS

```{r cox}
library(survival)
library(survminer)

### Univariate cox proportional hazards model on multiple covariates (here proportion of phenotypes)
Cox_df <- SID_cor
colnames(Cox_df) <- paste0("C_",colnames(Cox_df))

Cox_df$censor_corrected <- sce$censor_corrected[match(rownames(Cox_df),sce$sample_id)]
Cox_df$survival_months <- sce$survival_months[match(rownames(Cox_df),sce$sample_id)]
#add covariates 
Cox_df$age <- sce$age[match(rownames(Cox_df),sce$sample_id)]
Cox_df$gender <- sce$gender[match(rownames(Cox_df),sce$sample_id)]

## 1. Based on continuous cluster proportions
covariates <- Cox_df %>% select(-censor_corrected,-survival_months) %>% colnames
univ_formulas <- sapply(covariates, function(x) as.formula(paste('Surv(survival_months, censor_corrected)~', x)))
univ_models <- lapply(univ_formulas, function(x){coxph(x, data = Cox_df)})

# Extract data 
univ_results <- lapply(univ_models,
                       function(x){ 
                          x <- summary(x)
                          p.value<-signif(x$wald["pvalue"], digits=2)
                          wald.test<-signif(x$wald["test"], digits=2)
                          beta<-signif(x$coef[1], digits=2); #coeficient beta
                          HR <-signif(x$coef[2], digits=2); #exp(beta)
                          HR.confint.lower <- signif(x$conf.int[,"lower .95"], 2)
                          HR.confint.upper <- signif(x$conf.int[,"upper .95"],2)
                          res<-c(beta, HR,HR.confint.lower,HR.confint.upper, wald.test, p.value)
                          names(res)<-c("beta", "HR", "CI_low","CI_high","wald_test", 
                                        "p_value")
                          return(res)
                         })

res <- t(as.data.frame(univ_results, check.names = FALSE))
res <- as.data.frame(res)
res <- res %>% rownames_to_column(var = "group")

#Plot hazard ratios            
hr_prop <- ggplot(res, aes(x = reorder(group,desc(HR)), y = HR, color = p_value < 0.05))+
geom_point(size = 4)+
geom_errorbar(aes(ymax = CI_high, ymin = CI_low))+
coord_cartesian(ylim=c(0,50))+
geom_hline(yintercept = 1,color = "black",linetype = "dashed")+
scale_color_brewer(palette = "Set1")+
xlab("Cluster")+
ylab("HR for con_prop")+
theme_classic()+
theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90))

hr_prop 

##2. Based on categories (mean division of cluster proportions)
Cox_df_mean <- foreach(i = Cox_df %>% select(-censor_corrected,-survival_months, -age, -gender) %>% colnames,.combine = "cbind")%do%{
Cox_df %>% select(i) %>% mutate(mean = ifelse(Cox_df[,i] > mean(Cox_df[,i]),"B","A")) %>% pull(mean)
}
colnames(Cox_df_mean) <- Cox_df %>% select(-censor_corrected,-survival_months, -age, -gender) %>% colnames
rownames(Cox_df_mean) <- Cox_df %>% select(-censor_corrected,-survival_months, -age, -gender) %>% rownames
Cox_df_mean <- as.data.frame(Cox_df_mean)
Cox_df_mean$censor_corrected <- sce$censor_corrected[match(rownames(Cox_df_mean),sce$sample_id)]
Cox_df_mean$survival_months <- sce$survival_months[match(rownames(Cox_df_mean),sce$sample_id)]
Cox_df_mean$age <- sce$age[match(rownames(Cox_df),sce$sample_id)]
Cox_df_mean$gender <- sce$gender[match(rownames(Cox_df),sce$sample_id)]

covariates <- Cox_df_mean %>% select(-censor_corrected,-survival_months) %>% colnames
univ_formulas <- sapply(covariates, function(x) as.formula(paste('Surv(survival_months, censor_corrected)~', x)))
univ_models <- lapply(univ_formulas, function(x){coxph(x, data = Cox_df_mean)})


# Extract data 
univ_results <- lapply(univ_models,
                       function(x){ 
                          x <- summary(x)
                          p.value<-signif(x$wald["pvalue"], digits=2)
                          wald.test<-signif(x$wald["test"], digits=2)
                          beta<-signif(x$coef[1], digits=2); #coeficient beta
                          HR <-signif(x$coef[2], digits=2); #exp(beta)
                          HR.confint.lower <- signif(x$conf.int[,"lower .95"], 2)
                          HR.confint.upper <- signif(x$conf.int[,"upper .95"],2)
                          res<-c(beta, HR,HR.confint.lower,HR.confint.upper, wald.test, p.value)
                          names(res)<-c("beta", "HR", "CI_low","CI_high","wald_test", 
                                        "p_value")
                          return(res)
                         })

res_1 <- t(as.data.frame(univ_results, check.names = FALSE))
res_1 <- as.data.frame(res_1)
res_1 <- res_1 %>% rownames_to_column(var = "group")

#Plot hazard ratios            
hr_cat <- ggplot(res_1, aes(x = reorder(group,desc(HR)), y = HR, color = p_value < 0.05))+
geom_point(size = 4)+
geom_errorbar(aes(ymax = CI_high, ymin = CI_low))+
coord_cartesian(ylim=c(0,10))+
geom_hline(yintercept = 1,color = "black",linetype = "dashed")+
scale_color_brewer(palette = "Set1")+
xlab("Cluster")+
ylab("HR for mean_prop")+
theme_classic()+
theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90))

hr_cat 

##3. Based on categories (GMM division of cluster proportions)
Cox_df_GMM <- foreach(i = Cox_df %>% select(-censor_corrected,-survival_months, -age, -gender) %>% colnames,.combine = "cbind")%do%{
GMM_Cox <- Mclust(Cox_df[,i], G = 2)
GMM_Cox$classification
}
colnames(Cox_df_GMM) <- Cox_df %>% select(-censor_corrected,-survival_months, -age, -gender) %>% colnames
rownames(Cox_df_GMM) <- Cox_df %>% select(-censor_corrected,-survival_months, -age, -gender) %>% rownames
Cox_df_GMM <- as.data.frame(Cox_df_GMM)
Cox_df_GMM$censor_corrected <- sce$censor_corrected[match(rownames(Cox_df_GMM),sce$sample_id)]
Cox_df_GMM$survival_months <- sce$survival_months[match(rownames(Cox_df_GMM),sce$sample_id)]
Cox_df_GMM$age <- sce$age[match(rownames(Cox_df),sce$sample_id)]
Cox_df_GMM$gender <- sce$gender[match(rownames(Cox_df),sce$sample_id)]


covariates <- Cox_df_GMM %>% select(-censor_corrected,-survival_months) %>% colnames
univ_formulas <- sapply(covariates, function(x) as.formula(paste('Surv(survival_months, censor_corrected)~', x)))
univ_models <- lapply(univ_formulas, function(x){coxph(x, data = Cox_df_GMM)})

# Extract data 
univ_results <- lapply(univ_models,
                       function(x){ 
                          x <- summary(x)
                          p.value<-signif(x$wald["pvalue"], digits=2)
                          wald.test<-signif(x$wald["test"], digits=2)
                          beta<-signif(x$coef[1], digits=2); #coeficient beta
                          HR <-signif(x$coef[2], digits=2); #exp(beta)
                          HR.confint.lower <- signif(x$conf.int[,"lower .95"], 2)
                          HR.confint.upper <- signif(x$conf.int[,"upper .95"],2)
                          res<-c(beta, HR,HR.confint.lower,HR.confint.upper, wald.test, p.value)
                          names(res)<-c("beta", "HR", "CI_low","CI_high","wald_test", 
                                        "p_value")
                          return(res)
                         })

res_2 <- t(as.data.frame(univ_results, check.names = FALSE))
res_2 <- as.data.frame(res_2)
res_2 <- res_2 %>% rownames_to_column(var = "group")

#Plot hazard ratios            
hr_cat_GMM <- ggplot(res_2, aes(x = reorder(group,desc(HR)), y = HR, color = p_value < 0.05))+
geom_point(size = 4)+
geom_errorbar(aes(ymax = CI_high, ymin = CI_low))+
coord_cartesian(ylim=c(0,10))+
geom_hline(yintercept = 1,color = "black",linetype = "dashed")+
scale_color_brewer(palette = "Set1")+
xlab("Cluster")+
ylab("HR for GMM_prop")+
theme_classic()+
theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90))

hr_prop/
hr_cat/
hr_cat_GMM
```
